snippet.title: The Croods: Official game - out now!
snippet.description:
Official game for The Croods out now! http://rovio.com/thecroods

Play the official game for The Croods, the hit movie from DreamWorks Animation, coming to iOS & Android devices on March 14. The Croods will Hunt & Gather their way through spectacular new landscapes as they tame fantastic and never-seen-before creatures. Help The Croods survive the wild...and each other!

So stay tuned, watch this amazing custom animation from DreamWorks, and carve March 14 into your nearest slab of stone!


LIKE The Croods at http://facebook.com/thecroods for everything you need to know about the movie and game!

LIKE Rovio at http://facebook.com/rovioentertainment to find out about our latest games!
